shots.learning_intent: A vector is a displacement arrow, not a point.
shots.visual_metaphor: A pencil line grows out of the origin on graph paper.
shots.composition: Origin low-left, arrow into negative space, title small and off-axis.
shots.camera: Slow push-in from width 16 to 13 around the origin.
shots.continuity: The same origin and grid persist into the next shot.
shots.reference: 3Blue1Brown: concept first, labels later; no title card.

shots.learning_intent: Components and magnitude explain both direction and length.
shots.visual_metaphor: Shadow projections onto the axes reveal (3,2).
shots.composition: Arrow centered left; dashed components connect to axes; formula in right panel.
shots.focus: Arrow, then the dashed component path, then the magnitude label.
shots.camera: Hold at width 13 with a tiny lateral drift.
shots.continuity: Same arrow and origin; no cut.
shots.reference: 3Blue1Brown vector series: components as projections, not bullets.
acceptance: labels do not sit on the arrow

shots.learning_intent: Addition is placing the tail of b at the tip of a.
shots.visual_metaphor: A second pencil travels to the first tip, then the resultant closes the triangle.
shots.composition: Triangle grows right; formula sits in lower-right negative space.
shots.focus: The moving b tail → a tip, then the green resultant.
shots.camera: Pan right and widen slightly to keep the triangle in frame.
motion: b clone translates to a tip
shots.continuity: a stays fixed while b moves; same grid.
shots.reference: 3Blue1Brown: show the operation as a spatial action, not a formula swap.

shots.learning_intent: Scalar multiplication changes length; negative flips direction.
shots.visual_metaphor: A rubber band anchored at the origin stretches to 2a and snaps through the origin to -a.
shots.composition: Vertical breathing room above/below; labels beside arrow tips.
shots.camera: Pull back to width 15 so 2a and -a both fit.
acceptance: arrow head does not collide with labels

shots.learning_intent: The dot product measures projection times length; angle controls the sign.
shots.visual_metaphor: A light drops perpendicular from b onto a, leaving a shadow segment; the angle arc explains cosine.
shots.composition: a horizontal-ish, b above; projection shadow in green; formula upper-right.
shots.focus: The dropped perpendicular, then the angle arc, then the formula.
shots.camera: Slow orbit-like drift without rotating the grid.
shots.continuity: Same origin; a/b colors persist from earlier shots.
